description: This file defines a Polymer-based custom web component `<paper-tabs>` for material design styled tab navigation, including styles, template, and behaviors for scrolling, selection, and interaction handling.

methods.name: _computeScrollButtonClass
methods.description: Computes the CSS class for scroll buttons based on visibility flags.

methods.name: _computeTabsContentClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class for the tabs content container based on scrollability.

methods.name: _computeSelectionBarClass
methods.description: Returns classes for the selection bar element based on configuration.

methods.name: _onResize
methods.description: Handles resize events to update scrolling and selection bar position.

methods.name: _onIronSelect
methods.description: Handles tab selection events to update the indicator and scrolling.

methods.name: _onIronDeselect
methods.description: Handles tab deselection to update UI.

methods.name: _scroll
methods.description: Handles scroll gestures to move tabs horizontally.

methods.name: _affectScroll
methods.description: Updates scroll position by a delta value.

methods.name: _onLeftScrollButtonDown
methods.description: Starts scrolling left when scroll button is pressed.

methods.name: _onRightScrollButtonDown
methods.description: Starts scrolling right when scroll button is pressed.

methods.name: _onScrollButtonUp
methods.description: Stops scrolling on scroll button release.

methods.name: _scrollToLeft
methods.description: Scrolls the tabs container left by a step.

methods.name: _scrollToRight
methods.description: Scrolls the tabs container right by a step.

methods.name: _tabChanged
methods.description: Updates the position and size of the selection indicator when a tab is selected.

methods.name: _scrollToSelectedIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures the selected tab is visible within the scroll container.

methods.name: _calcPercent
methods.description: Calculates position or size percentages relative to container width.

methods.name: _positionBar
methods.description: Positions and scales the selection indicator bar.

methods.name: _onBarTransitionEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of selection bar animations to finalize position.
